purpose: Correct implementation discrepancies and test all eligible secondary factors, including the requested GATA3-EGR1 hypothesis.
corrections: Convert Ensembl one-based transcription start sites to zero-based BED coordinates.
Enforce the existing matching caliper on every control in a matched set.
Choose a secondary path by absolute intermediate response and alphabetical tie breaking, without ranking by signed agreement.
Use a centred regression t statistic for the univariate linear model activity score.
Exclude guide and K562 outcome evidence from molecular evidence-type counts and predictive features.
Fit feature imputation and scaling inside each target-held-out training fold.
Use target-clustered inference and require the confidence interval to exclude the null before a supported decision.
Label motif and curated evidence as regulatory support, never as directly occupied regulation.

secondary_factor_screen.population: Every eligible perturbed factor-state crossed with every measured eligible secondary factor with a primary signed regulon of at least five genes or a motif set of at least ten genes.
secondary_factor_screen.test: Two-sided Fisher competitive enrichment against all measured distal genes, reported as an exploratory screen; strong claims additionally require matched support, compatible direction, two molecular evidence types and independent perturbation.
secondary_factor_screen.negative_factors: Five nearest factors to EGR1 in standardized log primary-regulon degree and motif-set size, ties alphabetical, excluding EGR1 and GATA3.
secondary_factor_screen.targeted_sources: GATA3 and the same five degree-matched negative perturbed factors, every observed state.
secondary_factor_screen.matched_test: Use the frozen source-specific expression, chromatin, GC, interval, distance, degree and state matched gene sets, retaining only complete five-control sets within the existing 3.0 caliper.
secondary_factor_screen.missing_effect_rule: A zero in the thresholded response matrix means no retained significant response, not a measured zero effect.

prediction.model: Ridge alpha 10, target-hashed 10 folds from the frozen configuration
prediction.features: Existing cis, expression, cell-count, response-degree and state covariates; molecular support, higher-order support, molecular-only Tier 2/3, signed agreement and unstandardized source-regulon weighted mean
prediction.intervals: Absolute residual quantiles from the training data, labelled empirical intervals without conformal coverage claims

stopping_rules: No direct-occupancy comparison when the compatible occupied TF has no eligible perturbation response.
No independent programme-replication claim with fewer than 20 retained genes in either programme.
No state-specific chromatin or occupancy claim from unmatched peak collections.
No causal cascade or mediation claim from cross-sectional response summaries.
No additional resource downloads or validated primary model refits.
